 President Donald Trump has warned that much of his administration's progress could be undone if Democrats win control of Congress in the upcoming midterm elections. Speaking to Sean Hannity, Trump urged Republican supporters to turn out in force, asking them to pretend he was on the ballot. In a video shared on X, Gandhi urged Modi to choose any venue and proposed holding the discussion in front of the media and India's youth. He even suggested RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat as the moderator. Gandhi listed several issues for discussion, including the financial system, the US deal, the Adani case and Jeffrey Epstein. He also challenged Modi to file a defamation case over his allegations of foreign connections. Gandhi ended the video by urging an early debate and extending Diwali greetings to the Prime Minister.
